description: React calls components to compute the next UI tree. Pure, interruptible, no DOM changes.
React applies the minimal DOM mutations, then runs layout effects and, after paint, passive effects. Always synchronous.
Internal object per component instance holding type, key, props, hooks state and links to parent/child/sibling. Enables pausing and resuming work.
Diffing the new element tree against the previous one using two heuristics: element **type** and **key**.
Identity of an element among its siblings. Changing it remounts the component and resets its state.
Multiple state updates in the same event, timeout or promise callback produce a single render (React 18+).
